usedFor: ActiveCampaign holds contacts and campaign activity, and Freshsales Classic holds the deals that “Update Deal” changes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Added or Updated” in ActiveCampaign, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: Deal changes in ActiveCampaign carry over to the matching Freshsales Classic deal, found by deal ID or name.

watchOut: “New Deal Added or Updated” fires on updates too, so one deal can run “Update Deal” more than once.
